_help: SLIDIFY font styles. A style with "font": null is shown as 'font coming soon' and can't be picked yet. To fill one in: set "font" to the font name as Windows shows it, "file" to the font file (a path, or fonts/<file> for a file in the fonts/ folder next to this one), "index" to 0 unless the file is a .ttc collection, and adjust the sizes if needed.
